worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.summary: Throws an open iron trap onto a chosen spot, then walks away: the first enemy to step in is bitten and pinned where it stands, the jaws grinding until the duration ends or it is torn free. Wide is easier to trip but lighter and shorter; Tight lies longer and bites harder.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.use.0: Pre-set a trap on the path a foe must take
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.use.1: Seal one corner of a passage
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.use.2: Pin a charging target until allies finish it
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.use.3: Restrain a foe first when the fight is going badly
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.description.0: Stepping in and the jaws closing deals about %1$s damage; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.description.1: The trap opens a trigger circle of about %1$s blocks at the spot, waits %2$s, and arms %3$s after landing; it bites the first enemy to step in.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.description.2: A bitten target cannot move for %1$s while the jaws grind about %2$s damage every %3$s s; the trap also lets go if the bind is cleared.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.description.3: It slips free if dragged more than %1$s blocks from the spot; the trap throws up to %2$s blocks at about %3$s, closing at once if it lands directly on an enemy.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.option.on: Wide on: trigger radius about x1.45, wait about x0.85 and bite about x0.8, easier to trip but lighter and shorter, cooldown +4 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.option.off: Wide off (Tight): trigger radius about x0.85, full bite and wait about x1.15, lying longer and biting harder, for guarding a path a foe must take.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.timing: Throw the trap onto a spot within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.growth.0: At level %1$s the closing bite rises to %2$s power, the grind to %3$s, and the trigger to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.preference.wi: On: trigger about x1.45, wait about x0.85 and bite about x0.8, easier to catch whoever walks over it but lighter and shorter. Off (Tight): trigger about x0.85, full bite and wait about x1.15, lying longer and biting harder, for guarding a path.
worldcombat.skill.snaptrap.preference.ai: The companion only lays a trap on a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher sets the trap further along the foe's path.
Lead a moving target by this many ticks when laying the trap; 0 sets it where the target stands, higher is better against a charging foe.
On: only lay a trap for a moving or fleeing threat, leaving stationary targets to ordinary attacks; off: trap any threat in range.
